author: Mark Atwood
text:
Guide survey complete. No findings.

Quick stale-string greps (clean):
- 'Space owner', 'manage_emoji', 'server admin authorization': zero matches
- 'creator automatically', 'admin role automatic', 'non-owner', 'creator role', 'space governance': zero matches
- 'mention_all', 'hasMention', 'hasMentionAll': only present in chat push platform guide as field-name references (lines 142, 174), not restating computation rules — robust against f86f4f4 (hasMention rich-body) and any future fig9.4 changes

Deeper read-through (all three guides, 1183 lines total):

jmap-chat-push-platform-guide.md (206 lines):
- Suppression rules at :42-48 match push draft :200-205 ✓
- Urgency mapping at :141-145 matches push draft :209 ✓
- senderDisplayName referenced as a field only (:167), no derivation restated — robust against a908cdc (nick fallback) ✓
- hasMention/hasMentionAll referenced as booleans only — robust against f86f4f4 ✓
- Truncation 'Never drop' list (:174) intersects with push draft 'MUST support at minimum' (:119); guide is more conservative which is fine ✓
- Security notes (:188-206) match push draft Security Considerations ✓

jmap-chat-wss-guide.md (383 lines):
- ChatTypingEvent suppression rules (:45-52) now normatively backed by WSS draft after dim0 fix ✓
- ChatPresenceEvent suppression rules (:54-59) match WSS draft :253 (plus mention of 'visibility' which is forward-looking implementer guidance, not draft-contradicting) ✓
- Data type list at :113 matches WSS draft :123-131 (9 types) ✓
- 3s typing rate-limit and 10s decay timer (:232-234) match main draft :930 and :934 ✓
- 30s presence rate-limit (:321) matches federation :533 ✓
- Server-side delivery-time auth (:294-303) matches WSS draft :214, :374-378 ✓
- Credential expiry 1008 close code (:160, :343-346) matches WSS draft :107 ✓

jmap-push-platform-guide.md (594 lines):
- Operationally focused per-platform delivery details; not protocol-restating
- StateChange fallback (:564-566) matches push draft :219 ✓
- Web Push urgency enum (:459-464) matches push draft :94 ✓
- Vendor-visible payload warning (:574-578) matches push draft Security Considerations ✓

Items considered and rejected as findings:
- WSS guide :59 'recipient no longer has visibility of the contact': forward-looking implementer guidance for cleanup edge cases not currently spec-defined; not a contradicting claim, just defensible defense-in-depth wording. Bikeshedding rule applies.
- Guide files contain RFC 2119 keywords (MUST/SHOULD) in several places: pre-existing; AGENTS.md says 'Do not introduce' new ones, not 'remove existing'. Out of scope for this survey.
- The federation Tier 2 / Tier 3 hardcoded numbers (3s, 30s, 60s) are reflected in the guides — they're consistent with the current drafts; once uy1m 2D/2E/2F or ic5s T3-1/T3-2 land, the guides will need parallel updates, but they're not currently drifted.

No surveyed-finding beads filed.
